built.profile: release: opt-level s, lto, codegen-units 1, panic abort, strip; remap absolute vendor path to rapier-jxl-encoder
built.wrapper: src/lib.rs, Cargo.toml, specialize.py, bundled checksum-pinned jixel-0.2.27.crate

vendorModifications: specialize.py fixes the private RGBA8/sRGB wrapper configuration at compile time; no live coding algorithm or quality setting changes. The pinned Binaryen pipeline optimizes the result; images/codec-build.mjs verifies the binary and applies the existing runtime memory bound.

exports.encode: rgba ptr, width, height, lossless (0|1), distance -> encoded length; Modular lossless, or VarDCT at the given Butteraugli distance (images/encoder.mjs maps a quality number to it as libjxl did: q90 = 1.0, q95 = 0.55)
exports.encode_fast: rgba ptr, width, height -> length; jixel's port of libjxl's fast lossless, the bytes the previous encoder wrote at effort 1
exports.encode_rgb: rgba ptr (alpha dropped), width, height, lossless, distance -> length; the lossy path for opaque pictures, RGB only

optimization.notes: Semantics-preserving passes only. Rust opt-level s replaces z: the smaller z candidate regressed stronger lossless speed. Source specialization preserves active coding choices. No fast math, trap removal or live codec-mode removal. merge-similar-functions remains excluded.
